## Checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Reviewed before merging: a review pass on this pull request's changes (rule 10)
- [ ] Unhappy paths tested at the real size: two at once, an input twice, the real data size, a lost server (rule 9)
- [ ] Every new limit names itself (`shortcut: …`), and every store that grows says what bounds it (rules 3 and 4)
- [ ] Docs and diagrams describe the code as it is
